title: Icariin ameliorates minimal change disease by regulating the mitochondrial dysfunction pathway: an integrated strategy of network pharmacology, bioinformatics, and experimental validation.
authors: Wu, Hao; Wu, Rong; Zhong, Dian; Dai, Enlai; Chen, Li; Xue, Guozhong; Li, Xuping; Wang, Hanyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淫羊藿苷通过线粒体功能障碍通路改善微小病变肾病，涉及网络药理学、生信和实验验证，但核心是疾病靶点与药物机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，亦无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Minimal change disease (MCD) involves mitochondrial dysfunction. Icariin (ICA) has therapeutic potential. However, the exact mechanism by which ICA regulates mitochondrial dysfunction remains to be elucidated. This study investigated ICA targets and mitochondrial dysfunction-related genes (MDRGs) involved in MCD pathogenesis. METHODS: First, the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between MCD and controls were identified using differential expression analysis. Differential MCD-ICA target genes were obtained by intersecting the DEGs and MDRGs with ICA target genes. The four Cytoscape algorithms were then used to screen the differential MCD-ICA target genes for candidates, which were then refined through expression validation, machine learning, and ROC analysis to pinpoint the key genes. Next, a nomogram model of MCD was constructed. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), immune infiltration analysis, molecular regulatory network analysis, and molecular docking analysis were also performed using the key genes. Finally, reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) was used to validate the expression of the key genes in rat samples. In parallel, mitochondrial morphology was examined using transmission electron microscopy, and the ATP content in renal tissue was measured using colorimetric detection. RESULTS: Two key genes (ANPEP and XDH) were identified; both were downregulated in MCD. These findings were confirmed using RT-qPCR, with ICA intervention reversing their expression. In addition, the key gene-based nomogram demonstrated good predictive ability. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding between ICA and each of the key genes. GSEA revealed that the top three most prominent pathways shared by the two key genes included neutrophil degranulation and the innate immune system, with differential immune cell infiltration noted between the MCD patients and controls (e.g., resting dendritic cells and eosinophils). Twelve transcription factors co-regulated the genes XDH and ANPEP. Transmission electron microscopy and colorimetry confirmed that the ICA intervention alleviated mitochondrial dysfunction. CONCLUSION: ANPEP and XDH were identified as associated with ICA therapy and MDRGs in MCD patients. Furthermore, the potential ameliorating effect of ICA on MCD could be achieved by alleviating mitochondrial dysfunction. This work provides a potential theoretical basis for the treatment of MCD.
abstract_zh: 背景：微小病变肾病（MCD）涉及线粒体功能障碍。淫羊藿苷（ICA）具有治疗潜力。然而，ICA调节线粒体功能障碍的确切机制仍有待阐明。本研究探讨了ICA靶点及参与MCD发病机制的线粒体功能障碍相关基因（MDRGs）。方法：首先，通过差异表达分析鉴定MCD与对照组之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）。通过将DEGs和MDRGs与ICA靶基因相交，获得差异MCD-ICA靶基因。随后使用四种Cytoscape算法筛选差异MCD-ICA靶基因中的候选基因，并通过表达验证、机器学习和ROC分析进一步精炼以确定关键基因。接着，构建了MCD的列线图模型。还利用关键基因进行了基因集富集分析（GSEA）、免疫浸润分析、分子调控网络分析和分子对接分析。最后，使用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）验证大鼠样本中关键基因的表达。同时，使用透射电子显微镜检查线粒体形态，并通过比色检测法测量肾组织中的ATP含量。结果：鉴定出两个关键基因（ANPEP和XDH）；两者在MCD中均下调。这些发现通过RT-qPCR得到证实，ICA干预逆转了它们的表达。此外，基于关键基因的列线图显示出良好的预测能力。分子对接确认了ICA与每个关键基因之间的强结合。GSEA显示，两个关键基因共有的前三个最显著通路包括中性粒细胞脱颗粒和先天免疫系统，且MCD患者与对照组之间观察到差异免疫细胞浸润（如静息树突状细胞和嗜酸性粒细胞）。十二个转录因子共同调控XDH和ANPEP基因。透射电子显微镜和比色法证实ICA干预缓解了线粒体功能障碍。结论：ANPEP和XDH被鉴定为与ICA治疗及MCD患者中MDRGs相关。此外，ICA对MCD的潜在改善作用可能通过缓解线粒体功能障碍实现。这项工作为MCD的治疗提供了潜在的理论基础。
